summary: The one completed read-only task cold read (launch 2732e87b5b4c4772b43d4c422ee83258, session 01a09daf-d947-7c53-ad4f-f6f6ba18dce8, original task grounding 0d29041d614648a41b82c48ffabc913213991c7320d641da4dcf7302a517f5cc, brief 96c1236c31bb87a45954c64829c58aa6aa37c96d2565a8006e58c7a0709fefb3) produced eight findings. Each is resolved once in the amended story plan, Lean task plan, and protected 12-criterion contract. Three later requirements-read corrections strengthen context security, independent migration coverage, and clean-target/profile preservation. The later user-selected per-story event-log amendment changes only the Portable handoff: Lean still owns current pr-link staging/backfills and no event-family migration. The cold reader did not inspect the amended bytes. The final Lean task-plan body digest is 698eabb8e42d6bf7a7aa42269228ec2ff95e89dbc25da9369207f85b73082d27.
gaps: The cold-read plan deleted 12 of 15 Forge-owned profiles although active Decision 0074, the then-approved story plan, and a required regression retained all 15.
The cold-read plan removed grill-round floors and ledgers before the confirmed spec and Decision 0073's then-recorded Shared timing allowed their replacement.
The cold-read native approval design depended on Claude ExitPlanMode and Codex request_user_input events that Decisions 0029 and 0061 then described as unavailable or ineligible.
The cold-read plan assigned sealed fixed-proof migration to Lean although the then-confirmed spec and approved story plan assigned that complete migration to Portable.
The cold-read executable decomposition exposed only two broad Lean criteria/contracts while the task plan promised 12 independently testable outcomes.
The cold-read protected Lean write scope omitted review.py, review_brief.py, and signal.py even though the story plan assigned Lean behavior in those files.

The cold-read mandatory context-file security boundary had no implementation stage, focused selector, or reviewer instruction for its no-follow, identity, capacity, private-storage, cleanup, and metadata-only requirements.
The cold-read plan removed manual approval producers while leaving the replacement native approval storage, schema, atomicity, reader migration, and replay representation undefined.
resolutions: The final story/task plans cite the user's later direct recovery instruction and approved PR2 scope as controlling this bounded recovery, retain exactly planner-high/docs-decomposer/functional-checker as Forge-owned profiles, preserve client-added/client-modified profiles, and replace the stale 15-profile regressions with exact three-profile migration and preservation tests.

The final plans explicitly apply the later recovery override to the old Decision 0073/spec timing: Lean uses the one completed cold read with a complete one-to-one disposition and final-digest approval, removes compulsory round floors/authority ledgers and fake frontier questions, and leaves broader structured-question and coordinator-journey work to Shared.

The final plans explicitly apply the later recovery override to Decisions 0029/0054/0061 and bind only successful Claude ExitPlanMode and exact synchronous Codex approval events through one shared recorder, with stable runtime/session/event identity, current-frontier/current-digest eligibility, cancellation/malformed/async/wrong-runtime/replay refusal, and no fabricated display name.

The final story/decomposition assign Lean the complete fixed-proof candidate universe, lock, safety, origin=upgrade publication, sealed binding, active-proof fresh-review path, and normal fixed-file fallback retirement; Portable now owns only remaining non-review legacy families including the later event-log migration, so ownership is one-time and non-duplicated.

The protected decomposition now carries exactly the task plan's 12 acceptance criteria and 12 one-to-one plan_contracts, so task grill, stage proof, and review cannot pass on the former two broad statements.

The protected Lean write scope now has 93 exact entries including factory/scripts/forge_cli/review.py, review_brief.py, and signal.py, plus the focused hydration/review tests and the 96-file/14,500-line stop boundary.

The final plan assigns context-file work to Stage B and the in-scope delegate/admission/hook/library seams; it adds POSIX and native-Windows DACL selectors, same-user/no-follow/stable-handle/UTF-8/capacity/private-mode/delete/stale-cleanup/metadata-only proof, and explicit reviewer focus.

The final plan reuses the existing story plan-approval marker and task-grill approval fields behind factory/scripts/forge_cli/approval.py; CLI and runtime hooks are thin adapters, candidate/digest/event replay checks are atomic, re-grill invalidation remains, and no new approval artifact, schema, or parallel authority is introduced.
